results.title: Supreme Court raps Centre for stalling enforcement of Vedanta arbitration awards
results.content: Bench dismisses Union government’s challenge to a Delhi High Court order allowing Vedanta Ltd. and Ravva Oil (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. to enforce foreign arbitration awards involving claims of nearly $99 million

results.title: Delhi chokes: AQI 324, plunges to ‘very poor’; Stage-II GRAP invoked
results.content: The CAQM’s GRAP sub-committee noted that Delhi’s AQI had risen sharply from 117 in the moderate category on October 31 to 261 in the ‘poor’ category on November 1, before reaching 324

results.title: ‘Bada pataka’ under the counter, fake green labels on display: Banned firecrackers flood Delhi markets after Supreme Court nod
results.content: The Hindu finds rockets, bombs and flowerpots sold discreetly in Sadar Bazar and Jama Masjid, with some green-labelled crackers lacking QR codes; vendors cite demand for louder fireworks as police seize over 1,100 kg

results.title: How ‘Murasu’ became the first Tamil name for a tropical cyclone
results.content: ‘Murasu’ is the first Tamil name to be assigned to a tropical cyclone since the naming of cyclones over north Indian Ocean began in September 2004. ‘Murasu’ refers to a traditional Tamil percussion instrument.
